nodes.title: Stills: first frames from a still generator
widgets_values:
Stills: first frames from a still generator

1. Models: pick your files in the loaders on the left. This example was set up with FastH3 8-step v2 (fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_convrot) and the MiniMax ref2v turbo 8-step LoRA (minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_768p); with other models, match the scheduler steps to your LoRA. The text encoder and VAEs are on Hugging Face at Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3, and ComfyUI offers to download them when they are missing.
2. Click ▶ Render on the H3 Timeline node (it reads "▶ Render N remaining"). It queues one run per clip that is not rendered yet. Rendered clips and the finished video are saved under output/h3_sequences/h3_stills.

The nodes on the left generate stills with the original H3 model and feed the Timeline's still_recipe input.

In the Studio's Shots tab (H3 + References), generate a still for a clip's first frame, accept it as the guide, then render the video.
